'''Corinna A'Daasha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. After growing up in an opulent household, she left to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] before settling down with her [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister, [[Kandria A'Daasha]], on the planet [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. The twins founded and co-owned the [[Glow Dome]] [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] there. After meeting a member of the [[No-Holds-Barred]] underground group, Corinna became a sympathizer to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&mdash;she never formally joined, but she offered aid and safety to Rebel agents at her nightclub.

==Biography==
Corinna A'Daasha, nicknamed Cori by her friends, and her [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister [[Kandria A'Daasha]] were [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] into a wealthy family that provided for all their needs. As [[Youngling/Legends|children]], the sisters never struggled for anything, and although Kandria enjoyed a life of luxury, Corinna became bored and restless by it. Looking for excitement and adventure, Corinna ended up taking a portion of her wealth and leaving the A'Daasha household to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Separation did not suit either sister, however, and shortly afterward Kandria joined Corinna on her travels. Kandria convinced Corinna to travel to the pleasure world [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]], where Corinna enjoyed her stay and the two sisters decided to try their hands at business.<ref name="WHSV" />

The twins established the [[Glow Dome]] [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] together. Featuring elaborate sound and light displays, it became extremely successful. Even though the twins were co-owners of the nightclub and each had at the venue an office of her own, Corinna took care of the [[Local day/Legends|day]]-to-day operations, such as handling security, for the purposes of which she bought a used [[Lux|seeker droid]]. Despite her success, Corinna still felt unfulfilled by her life until she met a member of the underground group [[No-Holds-Barred]], who introduced her to banned [[Hologram/Legends|holomaterials]] concerning the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. Shortly after her introduction to the Rebellion's cause, Corinna became sympathetic to the organization, and although she never formally joined, she allowed underground holos to be sold at her nightclub and allowed Rebel operatives to use her business as a safehouse.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:KandriaADaasha-WHSV081.png|thumb|right|300px|Corinna A'Daasha's sister, Kandria A'Daasha]]
Corinna A'Daasha was the antithesis of her sister. Whereas Kandria enjoyed their luxurious lifestyle, Corinna's longing for excitement and adventure caused her to reject her opulent upbringing and made her sympathetic to the Rebellion. Corinna and her sister shared a love for [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]], although Kandria took more pride in her wardrobe collection and put more care into it: Corinna, on the other hand, despite enjoying pieces that she felt accentuated her features, would often wear the same clothing.<ref name="WHSV" />

Corinna had strong willpower and a wicked sense of humor: she enjoyed playing practical jokes, especially on boorish, obnoxious, and mean-spirited patrons of her club. She would also take revenge on people who upset her by using a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] to create illusions, such as altering the appearance of the woman those people were going out with. She would also use those projections to disguise her true self in order to fool her customers when [[Bartender/Legends|bartending]]. However, when people upset Kandria, whom Corinna often had to rescue, the latter did not stop at mere jokes and those people were never seen again. [[Cohden K'Reye]], a Corellian [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who often partied at the Glow Dome, nevertheless described Corinna as harmless.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Skills and abilities==
Corinna A'Daasha was an athletic person. She was also skilled in the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] as well as with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]], [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] and repairing, first aid, and security. Her talents also included bargaining, gambling, hiding, sneaking, searching, and persuasion, and she also had knowledge in various areas such as [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Language/Legends|languages]], [[Star system/Legends|planetary systems]], and on the workings of both the business world and the street world.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Equipment==
Corinna A'Daasha concealed both a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] on her person as well as a personal [[holoplayer]] and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. Most of the [[Time/Legends|time]], she wore a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]], but her wardrobe included a top paired with pants and [[Limb/Legends|arm]] bracelets.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corinna A'Daasha was created by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] and illustrated by [[Tom O'Neill]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. A'Daasha is a potential contact for Rebel Alliance&ndash;aligned player characters.<ref name="WHSV" />
